answer: An attacker who wants to forge hundreds of fake identities must fund a separate bond for each, so the cost scales linearly with every sock puppet while honest agents pay once. Sybil resistance via staked identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bond in the lagoon registry prior to voting, and peers verify the anchor against prior epoch history. Cheap identities become expensive, and reputation earned across epochs cannot be copied. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
